column1: Diversity and inclusion are core to Intel’s values and instrumental in driving innovation and delivering
stronger business growth. We have a responsibility to continue to be transparent about our progress
and our challenges, so we can partner with our customers and ecosystem to find better solutions
together.  We are proud of what we have accomplished to advance diversity in our workforce, but
we still have work to do, including beyond the walls of Intel. We have a comprehensive strategy that
includes partnering with diverse suppliers, diversifying our venture portfolio, and strengthening the
technical pipeline to encourage more women and underrepresented minorities to enter and succeed
